map_note: Only 91 of the state's 115 counties (St. Louis City counts as one) report so far in the Election Lab's Missouri data (source: Associated Press (AP) county-level advance-turnout feed, supplemented by direct county clerk contact), so every figure here covers those counties, not the whole state; the rest of the map is gray until more counties report. Jackson shows Kansas City only so far; Rest of Jackson County hasn't reported. Some counties are incomplete: 8 show in-person votes but no mail ballots; 1 shows mail ballots but no in-person votes; 11 show no mail-ballot requests, so none read as outstanding.

source.primary: UF Election Lab early-vote tracker (M. McDonald), Associated Press (AP) county-level advance-turnout feed, supplemented by direct county clerk contact; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 -- stand-in until the official source is wired
